description: This file defines the class BarStackedPlotAreaRenderer, which is a renderer for plotting stacked bar charts in the PDFsharp charting library. It calculates bar positions and determines whether data points are within the plotting range.

classes.name: BarStackedPlotAreaRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class responsible for drawing stacked bar plot areas, inheriting from BarPlotAreaRenderer. It calculates bar positions for stacked bar charts and contains logic for rendering such visualizations.

methods.name: CalcBars
methods.description: Calculates the position, width, and height of each bar across all series for the stacked bar chart.

methods.name: IsDataInside
methods.description: Determines if a given y-value lies within the specified y-axis range.
